### Issue URL (Incorrect Blocking) [https://play.hbomax.com/video/watch-sport/7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df/6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d](https://adguardteam.github.io/AnonymousRedirect/redirect.html?url=https%3A%2F%2Fplay.hbomax.com%2Fvideo%2Fwatch-sport%2F7b2a25cc-b973-540f-aa45-1ee93d6644df%2F6bacd0aa-71c6-4626-a9a4-64c72b09ee2d) ### Comment > The following rule breaks rewinding on live streams: > > ``` > play.discoveryplus.com,play.hbomax.com#%#//scriptlet('xml-prune', 'xpath(//*[name()="MPD"]/@mediaPresentationDuration | //*[name()="Period"]/@start | //*[name()="Period"][not(.//*[name()="SegmentTimeline"] or .//*[name()="ContentProtection"])] | //*[name()="Period"][./*[name()="BaseURL"]][not(.//*[name()="ContentProtection"])])', '', '.mpd') > ``` > > Unlike VODs, live streams start with a `<Period start=` that is not 0, so stripping that breaks the scrub bar. > > Live streams don't really have "inserted" ads (they have natural ads as a part of the TV channel's live broadcast output), so might be worth checking for `MPD@type`: https://dashif.org/Guidelines-TimingModel/#timing-and-presentation-types (live streams have `dynamic` while VODs have `static`) ### Screenshots
